checks.detail: Continuation sessions exactly equal frozen original V2 PLAN retained_test sessions 1-5. Each session has ten profile-specific 200-image jobs (five paired block IDs); 2000 rows/session and 10000 rows total. Retained SPLITS.test exactly equals V1's 1000 entries. Validation/reference test identity overlap is zero. This certifies frozen V2 job order, not reuse of V1's former job shuffle.

checks.subject: No refit, unsafe override or automatic retry in formal run path
checks.detail: safe_runtime rejects KMP_DUPLICATE_LIB_OK other than empty/FALSE/0 and rejects torch in parent/statistics processes. Original frozen evaluate(True) is reused: equal test-image and five-session weights, unchanged six tolerances and 500 crossed size-class/image-session bootstrap replicates. Main run stops on a measurement/statistical failure; no resume/refit/retry choices.

checks.detail: Parent imports only stdlib plus frozen v2_common/runner helpers; no torch/numpy timing-statistics mixture. Original runner check is a child; every frozen measure_block job is a fresh sequential child; statistics and export use distinct child processes.

checks.subject: Prelaunch prerequisites, one-shot lock and preservation
checks.detail: Confirmation accepted=true/all six criteria plus historical integrity and six-metric PASS are gated before launch. Fingerprint-bound passed entry review is required. Exclusive run lock, jobs, per-block logs and raw CSV/JSON prevent restart or overwrite; original STATE/RUN_STARTED/failure logs are protected. No test evidence, lock, state or TEST_REPORT existed at review.

checks.subject: Normal run failure behavior
checks.detail: Frozen evaluate(True) saves failed report/errors/Chinese result before raising. Failed statistics child aborts main run and preserves failed state, logs and raw rows; normal run does not export on gate failure. Complete state remains pending independent audit. Fatal native exits may leave last state rather than failed state; no auto-retry exists.

checks.subject: Same-day guard is not restricted to measurement

blocking_findings.title: Same-day launch guard also prevents legitimate later analysis and read-only auditing
blocking_findings.detail: prerequisites compares today's date to PLAN.frozen_at unconditionally. frozen_guard invokes it, so statistics-worker, export-worker and audit-all all reject on later dates even if every measurement occurred on the original day. The README advertises post-completion read-only audit-all and requires independent raw-row audit, but that valid later-day audit is blocked before record verification. Processing crossing midnight can likewise mark a completed same-day measurement run failed solely due to analysis date.
blocking_findings.required_change: In a new additive continuation revision only, restrict current-date same-day checks to measurement preparation/launch/block execution and verify recorded measurement dates during subsequent integrity checks. Keep source/PLAN/raw evidence frozen and obtain a fresh fingerprint-bound review.

blocking_findings.title: Direct complete export does not enforce successful test acceptance
blocking_findings.detail: export-worker is an allowed CLI action. It calls audit_all, which verifies report.integrity and plan_sha256 but never checks accepted or six passed criteria/support. A failed numerical TEST_REPORT with valid raw rows therefore satisfies audit_all and can be exported into v2_complete_service_requests.csv, fig_visual_service_v2_complete and COMPLETE_EXPORT.json via the direct subcommand. The main run path correctly stops on failed evaluate(True), but the callable export path violates the README's unconditional no success-like complete output after numerical failure.
blocking_findings.required_change: Gate complete export on report.accepted exactly true, all six frozen criteria passed, and no unsupported inputs, plus report/model/source bindings. Preserve failed reports/raw evidence and keep failure-only comparison outputs clearly separate. Re-review a new additive revision.

limitations: No retained-test timings, inference, preparation, resources, statistics-worker, export-worker, run or audit-all were executed.
B1/B2 are static control-flow findings; no clock was changed, no failed TEST_REPORT was fabricated, and no later-day/export bypass was dynamically executed.
The successful documented check is not evidence that future retained-test gates or full 23200-row independent acceptance will pass.
Historical confirmation audit limitations remain: same-day single-machine scope, sparse cells, no independent bootstrap endpoint rerun, and incomplete reproduction of the original OpenMP failure.
This review does not certify a global mixed-library environment, per-cell accuracy, deployment generalization, queue validity, vision accuracy or QLA benefit.
